crossRefs.note: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

“Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth…
“Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to…

translations.web: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
translations.bsb: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
translations.kjv: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.
translations.asv: For thou didst form my inward parts: Thou didst cover me in my mother's womb.
